record_requirements.submitted_recipe_utf8_sha256: Hash exact submitted source bytes, including literal fixed own collector key, explicit VIEW and registered caps
record_requirements.submitted_tool_cmd_utf8_sha256: Hash exact cmd string passed to exec_command; source-bound tool input, not hidden native argv or PID
record_requirements.own_result_key: Exact frozen literal own collector case/path/rawSHA key
record_requirements.retained_result: Actual exec_command return object read from only that own key, unmodified
record_requirements.retained_view: Exact VIEW object stored beside that actual result
record_requirements.retained_result_serialization_sha256: Hash explicit registered canonical JSON representation of observable object; never call it native wire/envelope bytes
record_requirements.returned_output_utf8_sha256: Hash exact strictUTF8 bytes of actual returned combined output string; never label as separate stdout or stderr
record_requirements.completion: Actual integer exit_code if available; otherwise record INCOMPLETE and forbid advancement
record_requirements.outer_rendered_observation: INTACT or TRUNCATED or UNAVAILABLE, based only on actual visible rendered items
record_requirements.outer_visible_items: Exact visible rendered text/items when obtainable; retain actual truncation text/metadata as visible observations
record_requirements.cursor_before: Explicit selected selector/start before this view
record_requirements.cursor_decision: ADVANCE only after intact original-slice validation, otherwise RETAIN
record_requirements.cursor_after: Same selector/start on either actual truncation fault or incomplete/error result
record_requirements.tool_runtime_trust: Explicit registered runtime return/forward/store trust boundary

rules: Schema strings describe requirements, not actual observations or values
Never fabricate hidden envelope, PID, separated streams, raw transport hashes or a truncation observation
Rendered truncation and retained nested output are different records; intact stored data does not make the outer rendered item intact
Observer retrieval does not itself advance the VIEW cursor or certify model consumption
A missing own result record fails capture availability; do not substitute guessed or resynthesized result data
If a call errors or fails before the observer store, a retained prior result is stale and cannot qualify this call; retain the error and do not advance or reuse the prior record
Full original field/identity/unit/bounds/gap/tail/EOF validation remains required for byte availability
Only observable byte availability and retry progress under explicit runtime trust are in scope
